reviews.title: Durable, Spacious, and Perfect for Gaming or Work
reviews.comment: I’ve been using the Corsair MM350 PRO mouse pad for a few weeks, and it has completely upgraded my desk setup. The extended design gives plenty of room for both my keyboard and mouse, allowing smooth and uninterrupted movement during gaming or work. The surface is premium and spill-proof, so I don’t have to worry about accidental drinks, and the textured fabric provides excellent control for precise mouse movements. The edges are stitched and very durable, preventing fraying even with heavy use. It stays firmly in place without slipping, making it reliable for intense sessions. Overall, this is a high-quality, spacious mouse pad that combines durability, comfort, and functionality.
reviews.author: Kyle

reviews.title: Massive, high-quality, and truly spill-proof!
reviews.comment: I am extremely impressed with the Corsair MM350 PRO. The size is perfect—it easily fits my keyboard and mouse with plenty of room to spare for low-DPI gaming. The "spill-proof" claim is no joke; liquid beads right up on the surface and wipes away without leaving a stain. It feels premium, the edges are stitched so there's no fraying, and the glide is incredibly smooth. Definitely a top-tier pad for any setup!
reviews.author: Bartek

reviews.title: Just how big is it? (See picture)
reviews.comment: This mousepad is incredible and I have to thank my fiancé for it. She put the idea in my head and I'm glad she did because before she brought it up, it was never even a thought in my mind. When she bought it for me, she asked if I thought the MM350 Pro Extended XL would be too big at a whopping 36.6" x 15.75" but it turned out to be perfect. I have a hybrid gaming machine / workstation setup for which I have a lot of tools and toys. So when you see those dimensions you may think to yourself, "Ok, that's a hair over 3 feet in length but just how big is it?" If you check the image attached, you'll see the Corsair MM350 Pro spread across a 47" wide desk. On top of it, I've placed the following items: - Logitech G602 (Mouse) - Logitech G512 Carbon (Keyboard) - Logitech F310 (Gamepad/Controller - Razer Tartarus Pro (Keypad) - Wacom Intuos Pro Medium (Graphic Tablet) - Wacom Pro Pen & Case (Tablet Stylus - Main) - Wacom Grip Pen & Stand (Tablet Stylus - Backup) - Focusrite Scarlet 2i2 (Audio Recording Interface) As a quick recap, that's a mouse, full keyboard, keypad, gamepad, audio interface, 15" graphic tablet and two separate pens pretty comfortably. Granted the tablet is only there when it's not in use, everything else can set comfortably without interfering with anything else. The thickness is pretty beefy at 4mm but personally I think it's perfect. Less might feel cheap but more might be less comfortable but these are suppositions. I love the construction of the mousepad as it feels well made, durable, soft, smooth and comfortable. My mouse GLIDES over the surface unlike anything I've ever experienced. The rubberized bottom is nice for keeping the mat in place no matter what I'm doing. Despite the mouse's ability to move effortlessly around the surface, the rest of my peripherals stay firmly in place which is especially great when using the Razer Tartarus Pro & Wacom Intuos Pro M for my work in Illustrator & Photoshop as I am able to use both within full range of motion without either peripheral moving on the surface of the mousepad (especially important for linework and complex path/shape building!). I haven't had a chance to test my forthcoming Razer Basilisk Ultimate vs 20k DPI sensor on this surface yet but it feels great and effortless whether I'm clicking on shapes or heads. It also ties the workspace together nicely and makes it looks neat and sharp. My only complaint about this mousepad is on this front and I didn't see a single person mention it: if you do not keep an exceptionally tidy workspace, do not get the black finish. My home office is currently shared as a thoroughfare between myself, two other humans, two dogs and three cats. Despite having a dedicated can of compressed air at the ready and a vacuum designed to stand up to the specific hassle that is constant animal hair shedding, the black is so striking that even a single dog hair or dust molecule contrasts so heavily that the smart money says your could see it from space. This is not the mousepad's fault obviously, just wanted to give other pet owners a buyer beware.
reviews.author: KC

reviews.title: Genuinely great mousepad
reviews.comment: Softest and smoothest mouse pad i’ve ever had; and i’ve gone through about 10. It’s so large and covers everything, absolutely great glide, the edges are smooth and don’t hurt your wrist / forearms. If you like having a clean setup, ample room, and a mouse that glides like butter; this is for you. I’d recommend getting it on sale though… lol
reviews.author: Widum Boise

reviews.title: Perfect mouse pad
reviews.comment: Easily one of my favorite mouse pads. Have had and used mine for over a year with daily gaming, and no issues. Good quality, it lays flat and cleans off easily. Mouse tracks perfectly on it. The size is great and covers a large portion of my desk, I especially like how wide the mat is. The thickness is nice and gives soft and durable feel. Corsair is always a good option.
reviews.author: Ashley M.
